item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.3

  • Choose which side of the screen your notes live on — Left or Right — from the menu bar or by right-clicking a note
  • The note's right-click menu now shows the real note colors, and every item has an icon
  • Fixes "An error occurred while running the updater" when installing updates
  • The close dot at the top of a note works, and closing works even when the note is pinned
  • A new note opens where you last left one; the pointer shows a hand where the title bar can be dragged
